annotations.title: Get the AI use policy questionnaire

description: Returns the short questionnaire behind draft_ai_use_policy: eight questions for a small business (company name, industry, AI tools in use, kinds of data the team handles, allowed uses, prohibited uses, who approves new tools, review cadence). Each question has an id, plain wording, type, limits and an example. Call this first, ask the person the questions, then pass their answers to draft_ai_use_policy. Takes no arguments, makes no network calls, stores nothing.
name: get_policy_questions
